name: JSONBuddy Core API
description: Provides JSON validation, JSON Schema validation, and JSON Schema documentation generation via a high-performance API.

commands.name: Validate JSON (Simple)
commands.description: Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema string using the /validate-simple endpoint.

schema.description: The JSON Schema as JSON escaped string to validate against.

data.description: The document as JSON escaped string to validate.

commands.name: Validate JSON (Advanced)
commands.description: Validate a JSON document using the /validate endpoint, supporting schema pools and structured JSON input.

schema.description: An array of JSON Schema documents to validate against.

data.description: The JSON data object to validate.

commands.name: Generate JSON Schema Documentation
commands.description: Generate HTML/SVG documentation from a JSON Schema using the /schematools/generate-documentation endpoint.

schema.description: The JSON Schema as JSON or JSON escaped string.

format.description: Output format of the documentation (e.g. html, svg).

endpoints.description: Validates JSON data against a provided schema or schema pool.
Validates JSON data against a single schema string.
Generates HTML or SVG documentation from a JSON Schema.
